before: A room baseline kept the cached w:sdtContent text of a data-bound content control.
after: The room creator refreshes data-bound controls from their store before seeding the baseline, so every participant starts from the bound value.
reason: Only the creator's initial baseline changes. Joiners read the seeded room state, so a room created by an older client keeps its cached text for every participant. Shared nodes, operations, and serialization formats are unchanged.
